iipimage_script_alias_path.description: The path where the iipsrv CGI script is located, used in the ScriptAlias directive.

iipimage_location_path.description: The URL path under which the iipsrv handler is exposed.

iipimage_verbosity.description: Verbosity level for the IIP server logs.

iipimage_logfile.description: Path to the log file for the IIP server.

iipimage_max_image_cache_size.description: Maximum number of images to keep in the cache.

iipimage_max_cvt.description: Maximum width or height of an image in pixels for processing.

iipimage_memcached_servers.description: Comma-separated list of memcached servers for caching.

iipimage_fcgid_idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout for FCGI processes in seconds. 0 means unlimited.

iipimage_fcgid_max_processes_per_class.description: Maximum number of FCGI processes per class.
